title: ‘Humboldt USA’ Is a Timely “Fraught Love Letter” to a Naturalist, Challenging Our Notions of Technology and Environmentalism (Exclusive Clip)
summary: G. Anthony Svatek's feature, debuting at Switzerland's Visions du Réel festival, explores the legacy of Alexander von Humboldt and his concept of interconnectedness by visiting U.S. places named after him.
